extraction.ownership_guide_prompt: Use case: faithful historical illustration or ornament extraction. Edit the ORIGINAL supplied source region. Select ONLY the COMPLETE finite connected original foreground engraved ornament shown in this reference. Retain every source-visible acanthus curl, stem, leaf, petal, figure, head, hand, foot, claw, tail, wing, prop and instrument, including all original fine hatching within foreground surfaces. Keep contacting figures together with their required shared mounts/props and ornamental structure. Remove the uniform dark crosshatched field outside the ornament and inside every true opening between its curls or figures, but keep the original dark hatching within the pale foreground bodies opaque. Preserve original inscriptions on actual foreground ribbons/vessels as source artwork; remove only extrinsic signatures/date labels/page rules/paper around the design. Do not cut or redraw the original forehead, facial features, source-visible anatomy, hatching or feathery leaves. This is one finite original ornamental network, with no inferred seamless tile, generic frame corner, symmetry repair or modernized leaf shape. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Clear the unwanted page or flat painted background and every genuine opening between subject parts. Selected pale, gold, blue or white painted or engraved subject surfaces remain opaque. Remove neighboring unrelated subjects and printed page rules, lettering or captions. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork. Do not symmetrize, beautify, redraw, sharpen, stretch or compress the hand-drawn original. Fine natural antialiased contours without stepped polygon cuts or paper halos. Genuine transparent alpha outside and within the real openings, no rectangle or checkerboard paint.
